meta.name: customer-journey-mapping-workshop
meta.description: Run a customer journey mapping workshop with adaptive questions and outputs. Use when you need to map stages, actions, emotions, pain points, and opportunities for a persona and scenario.

copy.tagline: 引导用户绘制客户旅程地图，发现痛点与机会
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统梳理用户与产品的交互全流程
copy.tagline_en: Guide users to map customer journeys, uncover pain points and opportunities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically map user interactions with your product

howto.what: 引导你完成客户旅程地图的创建。它会逐步提问，帮你定义用户角色、场景、旅程阶段、行动/情绪和优化机会，最终输出一张可视化地图和优先级排序的改进点列表。
howto.when: 当你需要为一个特定用户角色和场景绘制端到端的客户体验地图，并识别痛点时触发。例如，你说“帮我为新用户引导流程做一次旅程地图工作坊”。

say.text: 帮我为首次房东用户做一次旅程地图工作坊。
say.note: 启动工作坊，Claude 会开始提问。

say.text: 为从试用注册到首次体验价值的买家绘制旅程地图。
say.note: 指定场景，Claude 会据此生成阶段和内容。

say.text: 为流失风险客户的支持旅程组织一次工作坊。
say.note: 针对特定用户群体和场景，Claude 会调整问题。

howto.what_en: Guides you through creating a customer journey map by asking adaptive questions about persona, scenario, journey phases, actions/emotions, and opportunities. Outputs a visual map and prioritized improvement list.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to map the end-to-end customer experience for a specific persona and scenario, e.g., saying 'Run a journey mapping workshop for new customer onboarding.'

say_en.text: Run a journey mapping workshop for first-time landlords.
say_en.note: Starts the workshop; Claude will ask questions.

say_en.text: Map the experience of a buyer from trial signup to first value.
say_en.note: Specifies scenario; Claude generates phases accordingly.

say_en.text: Facilitate a workshop on the support journey for churn-risk customers.
say_en.note: Targets a specific user group and scenario.
